item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description: ||NL||**What's New in Version 0.1.2**||NL|| ||NL||**✨ New Features**||NL|| ||BP|| **Added dark mode support** for better nighttime coding.||NL|| ||BP|| **Introduced auto-save functionality** to prevent data loss.||NL|| ||BP|| **New customizable toolbar** with quick-access buttons.||NL|| ||BP|| **Integrated basic Markdown preview** for notes and documentation.||NL|| ||NL||**🐛 Bug Fixes**||NL|| ||BP|| **Fixed app crash** when opening multiple projects simultaneously.||NL|| ||BP|| **Resolved layout issues** in the settings panel.||NL|| ||BP|| **Corrected file export errors** for certain special characters.||NL|| ||BP|| **Improved stability** when importing large project files.||NL|| ||NL||
